items.title: Wife of assassinated ex-Haitian leader registers for presidential election
items.summary: There has not been an election in Haiti since before the death of Jovenel Moise in 2021.

items.title: Will Spain’s snap election in November bring a far-right party into government?
items.summary: Country’s sixth general election in 11 years could lead to far-right role in government for first time since Franco’s death Spaniards head to the polls on 29 November to vote in the country’s sixth general election in 11 years.
